name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Logan) Turkey Bacon Avocado or Ultimate Grilled Cheese Panini
brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (12300 S Draper, Riverton/Herriman & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Warm pressed white panini bread layered with roasted turkey breast, creamy avocado, bacon, and provolone/cheddar—one of Utah's most reliable fast-casual lunches.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich (no tomato or sprouts) or the Ultimate Grilled Cheese (Muenster & Cheddar on white bread) with a soft white roll.
watchOuts: Order on white bread rather than multigrain, and hold raw tomato slices
